metadata.title: Example Organization Custom Controls
metadata.remarks: A skeleton OSCAL catalog for an organization's own controls: one family, one control, one enhancement, one parameter. Replace every Example and example.com value. New controls belong in a catalog of their own, not in a copy of NIST's: an OSCAL profile can change an existing control but cannot add one, so the custom-controls-profile.json sample combines this catalog with NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 into one baseline. Keep your own control-id prefix (here dp) so it can never collide with NIST's families. Upload this file as a control catalog, then validate it against the OSCAL 1.2.3 catalog schema.

guidelines.prose: the frequency at which retained data is reviewed is defined;

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Review retained organizational data {{ insert: param, dp-01_odp }} against the retention schedule; and

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Dispose of data held past its retention period.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Explain why the control exists and how it is usually met. Guidance is informative; the statement above is what is assessed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: retained organizational data is reviewed {{ insert: param, dp-01_odp }} against the retention schedule;

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: data held past its retention period is disposed of.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enforce the retention schedule with automated mechanisms.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: An enhancement adds to its base control; a baseline may select the base control without it.
